title: Clean Web Landing & Expressive In-App Updates (v0.4.4)
message: Elevated GabAI with refreshed academic capstone landing portal, high-contrast expressive UI, and streamlined release assets.
changelog:
• Refreshed Capstone Web Experience: Deployed modern high-craft product landing page with official GabAI branding
• Dedicated School Admin Portal: Partitioned web portal for campus governance while mobile app serves students and teachers
• Expressive Dialog Engine: Hardware-accelerated frosted glass backdrop blur and 28dp tactile feedback dialogs
• Zero-Friction Class Joining: Google Code Scanner QR integration for instant student enrollment
